content.content: What is my Facebook security code? It's in an email I received recently.

To find your Facebook security code, you can follow these steps:

1. Log into your Facebook account.
2. Click on the arrow at the top right corner of the page and select "Settings & Privacy".
3. From the list, click on "Settings".
4. On the left side, click on "Security and Login".
5. Under the "Login" section, you will find "Use two-factor authentication" option. Click on it.
6. If you have two-factor authentication enabled, you should see a section called "Codes". Here, you can find your current security code.

If you don't have access to your email account where the security code was sent, you may need to follow Facebook's recovery process to regain access to your account.
